build_name: Seam Naturalizer / Transient Valley / Orbit Keeper Workstation
base: v1.5.0 Audio Supervisor + v1.4.2 State Engine
features: Seam Naturalizer: monitor-side discontinuity/speech-band heuristics with bounded post-detection 2.6 kHz clarity relaxation; no phoneme synthesis
Seam-aware Spark suppression: high seam confidence reduces transient enhancement so edit seams are not re-emphasized
Transient Valley: rising-edge post-impact unity GainNode envelope, device-capped 0.60..1.25 dB, safety pressure scales to 0 dB
Orbit Keeper: independent 1 s station-keeping supervisor with health score, timer-drift detection, hysteresis, staged recovery L1..L4 and safe-degraded baseline
No look-ahead or DelayNode added by v2.6; the new serial GainNode is unity at rest
Impact Liberation parallel transient lane: Integrity tap -> 1.4 kHz HPF -> 9 kHz LPF -> zero-idle Impact Gain -> post-Compressor Output sum
Compressor Escape: Fast Spark temporarily relaxes threshold/ratio and lengthens attack; ~70 ms controlled recovery
Impact is positive-only and pressure-scaled; scenePressure=1 returns Impact Gain and Compressor Escape exactly to the v2.4 baseline
Device-capped Impact Gain: headphone 0.20, stereo/multispeaker 0.24, smartphone 0.075, TV 0.14, portable 0.09
Unified Gain Arbiter: Auto Level baseline and nonnegative Spark makeup are composed once; commitEffectiveLevelGain is the sole runtime writer to the AutoLevel GainNode
Spark makeup moved after the shared analyser, so Auto Level does not measure and counteract its own transient addition
Additive-only Fast Spark: the 8 ms lane is separated from the 50 ms Scene/Multi baseline and cannot command values below that baseline
Fast Spark AudioWorklet side-chain with 2 ms/35 ms RMS envelopes and ~8 ms reports; no audible serial node
Strong-hit default makeup targets approximately +0.3..+0.6 dB; headphone/stereo/multispeaker hard cap +0.8 dB
Smartphone/portable makeup cap remains +0.2 dB; TV cap +0.45 dB
Limiter/safety pressure removes only the positive Spark delta and returns exactly to the slow baseline
Spark OFF suspends detector analysis; redundant AudioParam updates are throttled
Spark failure or stale-report fallback to the existing 50 ms Scene transient detector
Shared side-chain analyser reused by Scene Dynamics and Auto Level; removed analyser from audible serial path
Scene DNA 7-axis continuous state with 78,125 quantized addressable cells
Dynamic Exponent + Scene Inertia control law
Device Adaptation profiles for headphone/stereo/smartphone/TV/portable/multispeaker
Virtual Multi-Speaker coefficient renderer (Front/Wide/Ambient/Rear/Height mapped to 2ch DSP)
0.1/0.01-oriented precision numeric control infrastructure
Virtual DAC Matrix with AKM/ESS/TI-inspired bounded software profiles
ARTNOVION-inspired Room Engine with true dry bypass when off
Transmission/Power/Ground-inspired Integrity Engine with true dry bypass when off
RMS-based one-touch Auto Level with Quiet/Reference/DJ targets and bounded -12..+6 dB correction
2-Deck DJ mixer with independent gain/EQ and equal-power crossfader
AUTO MIX A->B / B->A with 0.1 s duration control
Virtual Cartridge Lab with three parallel response branches, mix and A->L/B->R split
Experimental external audio input via getUserMedia
Self DAP / Perspective / Virtual DAP / Safety Supervisor retained
true dry bypass for Self DAP, DAC Matrix, Room, Integrity and Cartridge OFF
transaction-safe Deck replacement and failure rollback
audio_path: Noise / EQ / Spectral Fill / Detail / Reality
Parallel Impact Liberation (1.4–9 kHz, zero-idle, bypasses Compressor only)
Transient Valley (unity at rest, no look-ahead)

notes: Valley uses post-attack dip rather than peak boost
Orbit Keeper is supervisory, not self-modifying DSP
OFF means no intentional audible delta from v2.6 mechanisms

limitations: real Windows Chrome/Edge two-tab DJ behavior not yet measured
real microphone/USB/line-input permission UX not yet measured
long-duration real-browser CPU/thermal behavior not yet measured
actual output-device 96 kHz support depends on hardware/driver
Auto Level uses RMS/dBFS, not physical acoustic SPL
DAC/room/cable/power/ground/cartridge modules are bounded software analogues, not physical/electrical emulation
no true DSD/native 1-bit or hardware DAC electrical emulation
no BPM/beat synchronization or webpage play/pause automation
physical 5.1/7.1 speaker routing is not claimed; Virtual Multi-Speaker remains a 2ch spatial renderer
Scene classification is heuristic DSP analysis, not semantic understanding of song titles/lyrics or real-world season
Additive Fast Spark is a bounded psychoacoustic modulation layer, not a linear-phase mastering transient designer
real-browser v2.5 recording is still required to measure the combined parallel Impact + Compressor Escape effect
offline Impact estimate is conservative because only the recorded post-Compressor v2.4 waveform is available; the new branch actually taps pre-Compressor audio
Seam Naturalizer is post-detection and cannot pre-crossfade an edit point without look-ahead.
Real sound-MAD false-positive/false-negative rates have not yet been measured.
Transient P95/P99 improvement must be measured from new v2.6 recordings.
Multi-hour/day browser CPU, thermal and long-run stability remain unverified on target hardware.
